shortlist.label: Atrial flutter with bradycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows atrial flutter and bradycardia, consistent with this diagnosis

shortlist.label: Bayés syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows prolonged P-wave duration and biphasic P wave morphology, consistent with advanced interatrial block

shortlist.label: Hypertensive heart disease
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has a history of hypertension and elevated blood pressure, which can lead to heart disease

shortlist.label: Diastolic heart failure
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has left atrial enlargement and elevated B-type natriuretic peptide, consistent with heart failure

shortlist.label: Sick sinus syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient's ECG shows sinus bradycardia and prolonged PR interval, consistent with this diagnosis

raw.rationale: The patient's ECG shows sinus bradycardia with prolonged P-wave duration and biphasic P wave morphology, which is consistent with advanced interatrial block, a key feature of Bayés syndrome. The presence of atrial flutter on follow-up ECG also supports this diagnosis, as Bayés syndrome is characterized by paroxysmal atrial arrhythmias.

rejected.label: Atrial flutter with bradycardia
rejected.why: While the patient does have atrial flutter, the presence of advanced interatrial block and other ECG findings make Bayés syndrome a more comprehensive diagnosis.

rejected.label: Hypertensive heart disease
rejected.why: Although the patient has hypertension, the ECG and echocardiography findings do not specifically support hypertensive heart disease as the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Diastolic heart failure
rejected.why: There is no clear evidence of diastolic dysfunction or heart failure in the provided information.

rejected.label: Sick sinus syndrome
rejected.why: While the patient has bradycardia, the ECG findings are more consistent with advanced interatrial block and Bayés syndrome than sick sinus syndrome.
